structure_and_depth.basis: Read continuously in ranges 1-100,101-195,196-287 against the original task and effective requirements. The candidate-indication-formulation-date unit anchors the longitudinal chains and prevents one phase or approval from being assigned to every use of a molecule. Each main case traces the computational contribution, prospective experiment, clinical checkpoint and organizational handoff. The histories provide mechanisms rather than a milestone catalogue: rentosertib separates target selection from molecular optimization; DSP-1181 explains measured property failures and iterative chemistry; EXS21546 separates engagement from therapeutic index; REC-994 links orthogonal screening enrichment to an eventual negative clinical decision; REC-4881 preserves inherited chemistry and uncontrolled/evaluable populations; baricitinib distinguishes nomination from the later randomized clinical contribution; halicin separates classifier enrichment, mechanism experiments and the independent virtual-library branch. Sections 6-8 synthesize these histories into distinct feedback types, comparable clocks and stage-specific investment gates. Partner structures connect rights, assay execution and access to feedback with actual deliverables, while cash/upfront/contingent ceiling remain separate. The reports limitations are integrated at the point of inference rather than replacing the causal comparison. Relevant originals inspected include AIDD-S14:213-229 (machine versus human selection and orthogonal assay) and AIDD-S20:188-194 (discontinuation and lack of sustained results). They support the report central distinction that useful screening capability and clinical success are independently testable. No material structure/depth defect found. This perspective does not constitute a medical recommendation, independent clinical reproduction or exhaustive source adjudication.
